@@ -5806,8 +5806,14 @@ float() Argus_Combat =
                 // point while chasing it - the shot arrives where

+                dy = want - self.angles_y;

+                if (coop <= 0 && fabs (dy) < 8
+                    && !self.ar_prefired && self.ar_skill >= AR_SKILL_PREFIRE
                     && self.weapon == IT_ROCKET_LAUNCHER

                         to = vectoangles (self.ar_lastseen

                         // vectoangles pitch is up-positive; v_angle
                         // wants down-positive (the RJ convention)
                         self.v_angle_x = 0 - to_x;
-                        self.v_angle_y = to_y;

@@ -6845,7 +6853,10 @@ float() Argus_Combat =
         // shot we are about to take, and if a team mate is what it

limitations: Physical fixture uses full combat, actual collision hulls and stock weapons. Rockets are counted on emission and removed; no flight-damage claim.
Central-ray ally safety does not establish shotgun-spread or splash immunity. Existing splash safety is unchanged.
Three ordinary tapes per arm on each map are a bounded native comparison, not a human-play judgement.
No installed program or historical tape changed.
Native comparisons approve parity on dm2 and dm4. They do not demonstrate improvement; all statistical confidence intervals include zero.
Secondary pickup summaries flag dm2 and warn on dm4. All twelve tapes have zero freezes and zero under-fire freezes.
